title: When you need forgiveness
line: For guilt, regret, or forgiving yourself.
intro: Guilt can be honest, and it can also be a trap. This practice is for owning what you did, asking forgiveness, and then setting the weight down.

steps.title: Arrive
steps.text: Sit comfortably, with your back upright and soft. Follow the circle: in as it grows, out as it settles. Never strain.

steps.title: Light the lamp
steps.text: Light a real diya if you have one, or this one. Let the flame be the centre of your attention for a moment.

steps.title: Ask forgiveness
steps.text: A prayer to Shiva for forgiveness of everything done by hand, foot, word, sight or thought, knowingly or not.

steps.title: Own it
steps.prompt: What do I regret? Is there anything I can still put right?

steps.title: Set it down
steps.text: Write what you have carried long enough, and offer it to the fire. Forgiving yourself is part of the practice.

steps.title: Close
steps.text: Read the closing prayer once, slowly. Then sit for one more breath before you return to your day.

after: If there is a person to make amends with, that can be the next step. Guilt that never lifts is worth talking about with someone.
